runtime_lifecycle_regression.observed: Both bootstrap records used task API v3 and one UDS. Pause Shutdown returned while the shim still served one container. After tasks/CRI/Sentry/gofer were gone the shim stayed idle in the unbounded containerd service cgroup. SIGUSR1 captured idle reaper/processExits/forward stacks; SIGQUIT was diagnostic only.
runtime_lifecycle_regression.source_interpretation: The guest container had SandboxID=pauseID. In containerd 2.2.0 that sandboxed v3 child deletion skipped a subsequent Shutdown. The fixed gVisor shim only exits when Shutdown observes an empty container map; deleting the last child without another Shutdown leaves the idle shim.
runtime_lifecycle_regression.fix_validation: Official containerd 2.4.2 contains the fix. R18 changes the runtime with the historical guest32 budget and passes all plus three fresh OOMs. R20 validates the final guest64/host256 combination; no acceptance signals or custom reaper.
